target_year_over_year_context.explanation: The 2023 disclosure (ms_2023_7_D090) covers the projected future compensation obligation for DCP. It contains two main components: 1) The accounting treatment/rollforward basis (reflected in Other liabilities, excludes market condition assumptions, performance years) and 2) The segment distribution breakdown. The 2024 disclosures split this: D094 covers the accounting treatment/balance location/rollforward basis, and D095 covers the segment distribution breakdown. Both 2024 items are subsets of the original 2023 topic.

comparisons.peer_summary: There was a $128 million net addition to the allowance for lending-related commitments recognized in other liabilities on the Consolidated balance sheets.
comparisons.comparison: Both MS and JPM disclose specific obligations or reserves recognized in 'other liabilities' on the Consolidated Balance Sheet. MS classifies the balance for projected future compensation in 'Other liabilities and accrued expenses' to account for deferred cash-based compensation related to performance years 2024 and prior. Similarly, JPM reports a net addition to the allowance for lending-related commitments, which is also recognized in 'other liabilities' on the Consolidated balance sheets. While MS reflects an operating compensation obligation and JPM reflects a credit loss allowance, both items are explicitly categorized under the same balance sheet line item of other liabilities/accrued expenses for their respective fiscal year-end obligations.
